mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, the current temperature is 63 degrees with heavy rain affecting Harriet Park under the light of a Waning Gibbous moon.

The city is performing road surface treatments from August 4 to August 7 starting on Lincoln Street, and property owners can apply for a 100 dollar toilet rebate for installing high-efficiency models.

Today, August 1, is packed with activities including the Remote Area Medical clinic at Verona Area High School, the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree at Seven Acre Dairy Company, and the Dane County Farmers Market.
Regarding the weekly police report, on July 23, officers arrested a 23-year-old man for disorderly conduct and intimidation of a victim following a domestic disturbance on Lucerne Drive.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Chocolate Volcano. Since the store is currently closed, you can stop by when they open at 10 AM today.
